value: plants grown under six set irradiance levels: higher light reduced leaf size, aerial dry mass and chlorophyll and raised stomatal density, chloroplast size and number and respiration; triterpene acid yields and dry mass peaked at 16 and 33 percent of full sunlight
method: potted plants grown under six light levels (shade nets), growth, photosynthesis, chloroplast ultrastructure and ursolic and oleanolic acid measured
conditions: six irradiance levels from full sunlight down; plants described as highly shade tolerant

source.authors: Zhang LX, Guo QS, Chang QS, Zhu ZB, Liu L, Chen YH
source.title: Chloroplast ultrastructure, photosynthesis and accumulation of secondary metabolites in Glechoma longituba in response to irradiance

where: journal abstract page opened through WebFetch
quote: With the reduction in the light intensity, the light-saturated net photosynthetic rate, the aerial dry mass per plant, and the yields of ursolic and oleanolic acid decreased after an initial increase, peaking at 16 and 33% of sunlight levels.
note: Abstract only. Set-light-intensity trial counted under sense_light_nonvisual (desk-screen 10(d)). Glechoma longituba is an accepted species on POWO (checked 28 Oct 2026), a congener of the queue's G. hederacea, so the value is genus-level for that cell. The fetch tool returned the sentence in two pieces, which are joined here. Zhang et al. 2023 (Photosynthetica 61(3): 264-274, 10.32615/ps.2022.046) is a companion trial with coloured films, not logged because no whole sentence could be read.
